hypothesis: Learn a mixture of shared and context-dependent multivariate response priors, condition on each available measured source response and uncertainty, and project V66 toward a posterior interval for an unseen context.
novelty: First covariance-mixture GP conditional response model in this project. Earlier scalar pooling/shrinkage averaged effects; V84 fitted a mean response operator on different essential targets. This model learns sharing patterns across the actual panel response coordinates and propagates conditional uncertainty. Independent mash-inspired adaptation, not mashr or a published CRISPR predictor reproduction.
sources: Legacy measured K562,CD4,H1,HCT116,HEK293T responses and masks; same bounded90%-dose cube as V66. Convert to log1p(50000*proportion) response with derivative-propagated sampling variance floor0.0025. Every panel gene excluded as an output.
kernel: Fixed common expressed nonpanel rank axis (>5CPM and finite in every allowed source), centered unit rank vectors. Source kernel0.8*exp(-(1-inner_product)/length)+0.2I; length0.05,0.2,1,4 or all-ones shared base. Query ranks use finite observed values with missing embedding coordinates zero (unknown centered-rank feature, not imputed RNA); >=90% measured required. Positive-semidefinite RBF embedding; query-specific0.2 variance remains unobserved.
mixture: Null component plus four signal SDs0.025,0.1,0.4,1.0 times five kernels =21 covariance components. Fit mixture weights to20000 deterministic source target/output coordinates with>=2 valid sources, using exact small Gaussian marginal likelihood,100 EM updates or max weight change<1e-7,0.5 component pseudocount. Gene coordinates are dependent working-likelihood units, not independent biological replicates.
boundaries: Whole H1,Orion(HCT116+HEK293T),or CD4(all states/donors) excluded from every training response, covariance fitting and conditioning. Query NTCs only for embedding, original V66 baseline, and inversion. D3 is reused after V84, not blind.
arms: Primary interval25: project V66 assay response into central80% posterior interval, invert to LFC and apply quarter of bounded+/-0.5LFC correction. posterior25 uses posterior mean instead. shared25 independently fits mixture weights restricted to shared-kernel/null components and uses interval correction. interval25_shuffled refits the full prior with independently shifted source target labels and conditions on those shifted responses.
guard: Original80% V66 identity-margin guard. Own/panel effects unchanged. Missing measured source entries abstain; entirely unsupported coordinates and insufficient query rank coverage return baseline exactly.
development: All655 reused public pairs. Primary must lower equal-study profile error>=0.5%, worst-study<=1.03, PDS loss<=0.005, and beat both shared-only and refitted target-shuffled control profile error. All arms reported; no recipient-based selection or hyperparameter tuning.
counts: Always test fixed primary, shared and refitted-shuffled control on original14-target D3 cohort, seed0, unchanged residual10 and matched400-cell templates/libraries/reference. Reuse14 previously validated V84 V66 baseline populations only after exact predictor/CPM/cohort/code equality checks. Emit42 new populations, independently replay all56. No duplicated cells or treated inputs for inference.
count_gates: Profile error must not increase; PDS loss<=.005,FID loss<=.002,reach loss<=.005,JAC loss<=.0005,NMAE<=1.01baseline; >=3 endpoints improve and profile beats both controls. A second unchanged seed620000 only if development and first count gates all pass. No package otherwise.

literature.idea: Multivariate adaptive shrinkage learns heterogeneous effect sharing; its genomic association benchmarks do not establish VCC performance.
Author method documentation; software not executed.
